== Missing data ==
* No Ben Lacey Star Trek CCG decklist found. Decipher's DecipherCon 1999 deck page posted only Mike Harrington's Star Trek deck ([https://web.archive.org/web/20000128052049/http://www1.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/decks/index.html Internet Archive]). The 1999 Round of 12 and prelim message-board reports linked from Decipher's Star Trek World Championship page were not captured.
* No Star Wars CCG results found: he is not on any DecipherCon 1999 Star Wars score sheet, and the DeckTech archive names him only in Steven Lewis's 2000 Worlds report. His 2000 Star Trek record before the disqualification is not posted.
* Not added: the 1999 Star Trek finalists list also has Ray Lacey of Franklin, Tennessee (Wizard World Invitational winner), whom Ben beat in prelim game 4. Decipher's "Lacey gang" caption does not name the other member, so the page does not link the two.
